method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: US Stocks Draw Record Weekly Inflows as Investors Pile Into Tech
Equities.reason: Large, tech-focused fund flows are a strong, market-wide risk-on signal reinforcing the AI/tech leadership narrative and supporting equity valuations; high relevance because flows directly drive price action across the market.

Equities.title: Fedspeak vs. war deal: Here are the things that drove this week's stock market
Equities.summary: The S&P 500 surged on Thursday, making up for losses seen after central bankers convened.
Equities.reason: Captures the dual macro drivers — central-bank rhetoric (liquidity/yields risk) versus geopolitical peace optimism — that set the broad market regime; scored positive because net effect described was a market rebound, but central-bank risk tempers relevance.

Equities.title: Weekly inflows into global equity funds hit 19-month highs on Iran deal optimism
Equities.reason: Geopolitical de‑risking (Iran deal) producing broad global equity inflows — a clear risk-on catalyst that amplifies the market rally and cross-border flow dynamics.

Equities.title: Wall St Week Ahead Investors see Micron earnings as pulse check of AI rally momentum
Equities.reason: Micron results are a key earnings read on the sustainability of the AI-driven rally — high relevance to sector leadership and broader market direction; treated as a potential confirmatory event for the AI narrative.

Equities.title: The riskiest SpaceX stock trade of all had a big first week
Equities.summary: SpaceX's IPO did not just mint the biggest debut in market history and a trillionaire, but it also triggered a historic land grab in risky leveraged ETFs.
Equities.reason: Highlights idiosyncratic but market-relevant retail/speculative flows and leverage via ETFs after a mega-IPO — supportive of risk appetite but lower relevance than macro/flow themes.

Equities.title: FTSE 100 flat as investors weigh US-Iran peace talks, energy stocks support
Equities.reason: Regional equity reaction to US-Iran peace talks — modestly positive via eased geopolitical premium and energy-stock dynamics; lower relevance because it's regional and not a market‑moving new regime shift.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve Board and Federal Open Market Committee release economic projections from the June 16-17 FOMC meeting
Rates.summary: Federal Reserve Board and Federal Open Market Committee release economic projections from the June 16-17 FOMC meeting
Rates.reason: FOMC projections are a primary signal of Fed policy path; a hawkish or higher-for-longer projections profile supports US yields (bond sell-off). High relevance for global rates.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
Rates.reason: The FOMC statement gives the immediate policy/communication stance; a hawkish or cautious-tone statement tends to push yields up. Important but slightly lower relevance than the projections.

Rates.title: Bank Rate maintained at 3.75% - June 2026 Monetary Policy Summary and Minutes
Rates.summary: The Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee is responsible for making decisions about Bank Rate.
Rates.reason: BoE left Bank Rate unchanged but minutes shape forward guidance; a neutral-to-slightly hawkish tone keeps gilt yields supported, modest negative for bonds.

Rates.title: Asset Purchase Facility: Gilt Sales – Market Notice 19 June 2026
Rates.summary: This Market Notice sets out the schedule for sales in Q3 2026 of gilts held in the Asset Purchase Facility (APF) for monetary policy purposes.
Rates.reason: Planned gilt sales increase net supply and are directly negative for gilt prices (yields up). Strongly relevant for UK rates and market liquidity.

Rates.title: Treatment of the Relaxation of the Terms and Conditions for the Securities Lending Facility
Rates.reason: Relaxing securities-lending terms increases liquidity/support in JGB markets, modestly positive for bond prices (yields down).

Rates.title: UK Bonds Fall as Burnham Win Leaves Markets Speculating on Risks
Rates.reason: Headline indicates bond selling in UK on political/fiscal risk and renewed concerns — negative for gilts and raises yields; meaningful market impact for UK rates.

Rates.title: Massive bonuses for South Korea's chip workers puts central bank on inflation alert
Rates.summary: Workers from tech industries receive bonus worth millions of won, prompting the Bank of Korea to warn of the upward pressure to inflation.
Rates.reason: Domestic wage/bonus pressures can prompt the Bank of Korea to lean tighter, supporting Korean yields; regional inflation risk is modestly negative for bonds.

Rates.title: United States Dollar: Fed stance and data keep support – Nordea
Rates.summary: Nordea analysts expect the Dollar to stay supported in coming months as the Federal Reserve maintains a relatively hawkish stance and US data remain firm. They argue that US growth and inflation dynamics justify higher yields versus peers, limiting Dollar down
Rates.reason: Nordea highlights a hawkish Fed and firm US data justifying higher US yields; FX piece but directly implies upward pressure on US rates (negative for bond prices).

Rates.title: Global data: Flash PMIs and inflation focus – Deutsche Bank
Rates.summary: Deutsche Bank’s Galina Pozdnyakova, Jim Reid and Luke Templeman highlight that next week’s main macro focus will be global flash PMIs and several key inflation releases.
Rates.reason: Upcoming PMIs and inflation prints are the primary short-term drivers of rate volatility; overall focus supports vigilance for further upward pressure if data surprise to the upside.

Rates.title: AI buildout gives tech investors new reasons to watch bond market
Rates.summary: Tech giants are depleting cash reserves and raising debt in their ambitious data center buildouts, a dynamic that's forcing investors to watch interest rates.
Rates.reason: Increased corporate issuance to finance capex raises supply needs and sensitivity to yields; incremental negative pressure on bond prices (yields up), relevant to credit and IG space.

Rates.title: India Rate Setters See Outlook Improve as Middle East Risks Ease
Rates.reason: Improved outlook and easing external risks can reduce local risk premia and ease pressure on policy tightening — small positive for Indian government bonds (yields down), but low relevance globally.

FX.title: The US Dollar remembers how to rally
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY) spent the back half of this week doing something most desks had written off six months ago: rallying on the prospect of a Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike.
FX.reason: Clear USD-centric macro signal: renewed Fed-hike expectations driving broad DXY strength. High relevance because this is a cross‑market driver (rates → FX) and underpins many other currency moves.

FX.title: Why Japan's $70 billion-plus intervention and a rate hike didn't prop up the yen more
FX.summary: Japan was willing to step in to defend the yen around the 160 level before, and it's at that point again.
FX.reason: Major FX-native event: huge official intervention and BoJ moves failed to arrest yen weakness, reinforcing USD strength and intervention risks. Very high relevance given central‑bank action and its market impact.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Yield spreads keep pair elevated – Nordea
FX.summary: Nordea expects USD/JPY to remain high as wide US–Japan yield differentials persist and the Bank of Japan stays very accommodative. While some gradual BoJ normalization is anticipated, it is seen as too modest to materially weaken the Japanese Yen near term.
FX.reason: Structural FX narrative: persistent US–Japan yield gap and BoJ accommodation support USD/JPY upside. High relevance as it explains a durable driver (rates differential) for yen underperformance.

FX.title: Euro: Limited upside as policy diverges – Nordea
FX.summary: Nordea’s research suggests EUR/USD upside is constrained in coming months by interest rate differentials and relative growth. The European Central Bank is seen closer to the end of its hiking cycle than the Federal Reserve, while Eurozone data remain softer th
FX.reason: Policy-differential narrative: ECB nearer the end of hikes vs Fed keeps EUR/USD capped. Relevant for EUR positioning vs USD but slightly lower than direct market-moving items.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar languishes near April 2025 low amid weak Retail Sales and lower Oil prices
FX.summary: USD/CAD trades on the front foot on Friday despite a modest pullback in the US Dollar (USD), as weaker-than-expected Canadian Retail Sales data weighs on the Canadian Dollar (CAD). At the time of writing, the pair trades around 1.4170, its highest level since
FX.reason: FX-native flow: weaker Canadian domestic data plus lower oil reduces CAD support, lifting USD/CAD. Medium relevance as it signals commodity‑linked FX being hit by both USD strength and local fundamentals.

FX.title: Swiss Franc sinks by design, not by peace
FX.summary: The Swiss Franc is the weakest major into the weekly close, dragging USD/CHF to a fresh high for the year. The tidy explanation is a wartime safe-haven bid unwinding now that the US and Iran have struck a deal; the trouble is that the Franc was never much of a
FX.reason: Safe‑haven unwind + USD strength: CHF weakness is consistent with lower risk premia and DXY strength. Relevant as it shows safe‑haven flows reversing, but less central than Fed/BoJ stories.

FX.title: The Euro sinks on its own rate hike
FX.summary: The Euro did something this week that ought to be impossible: it fell in the same fortnight the European Central Bank (ECB) delivered its first interest rate hike since 2023.
FX.reason: Market reaction paradox: EUR fell despite ECB hike, underscoring dominance of USD/Fed narrative and market positioning. Moderately relevant as it highlights counterintuitive FX moves tied to broader rate expectations.

FX.title: Forecasting the upcoming week: US Dollar loses momentum ahead of key US inflation data
FX.summary: The week ahead will bring a fresh test for major currency pairs as investors digest the first Federal Reserve (Fed) policy decision under Chair Kevin Warsh and look ahead to the United States (US) Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) data, global PMI releas
FX.reason: Minor counter-signal: preview of data/event risk that could pause USD strength. Low relevance because it's forward-looking and does not yet overturn prevailing USD/BoE/BoJ narratives.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar extends decline as Fed tightening expectations support US Dollar
FX.summary: NZD/USD trades around 0.5740 at the time of writing on Friday, down 0.28% on the day, as the US Dollar (USD) continues to benefit from expectations of a restrictive monetary policy stance in the United States (US).
FX.reason: Broad‑based USD theme: NZD weakness adds evidence that Fed tightening expectations are supporting USD across commodity and EM currencies. Moderate relevance as another corroborating datapoint.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG slides below 200-day SMA, bears target $61
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) price tumbles for the third consecutive trading day, down over 3.32% on Friday, courtesy of broad US Dollar (USD) strength and rising US Treasury yields, which have aimed higher since Wednesday amid the Fed's hawkish tilt.
Commodities.reason: Silver under pressure from USD strength and higher U.S. yields tied to a hawkish Fed — a clear negative price impulse for precious metals; medium-high relevance given market-wide USD/yield driver.

Commodities.title: Hawkish Fed signals send gold to third straight weekly loss
Commodities.reason: Broad macro driver: Fed hawkish repricing lifts USD and yields, which is the dominant negative force for gold this week — high relevance as it reflects the primary market regime.

Commodities.title: Goldman Sachs Lops $500 Off Gold Target on No Fed Cuts This Year
Commodities.reason: Analyst target downgrade citing no Fed cuts reinforces the dominant bearish gold narrative (USD/yields). Market-impactful analyst call but somewhat narrower than central-bank action.

Commodities.title: Permian natural gas production increased faster than crude oil
Commodities.summary: The Permian region's marketed natural gas production grew from 17.2 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in 2021 to 27.6 Bcf/d in 2025, a 60% increase, according to data from our latest Short Term Energy Outlook. Over the same period, crude oil production grew b
Commodities.reason: Material supply growth in Permian gas (60% since 2021) is a negative fundamental for natural gas prices — clear supply-driven bearish signal with solid relevance to the gas market.

Commodities.title: Brent at $80: Did the market buy the Iran deal twice?
Commodities.summary: Brent is back near $80 and West Texas Intermediate near $77, which means the Oil market has handed back almost the entire premium it built over nearly four months of open war with Iran.
Commodities.reason: Oil market has largely unwound the wartime premium — a negative/neutral signal for near-term oil prices as risk premium fades; relevant for short-term crude positioning.

Commodities.title: Crude Oil has the right glut on the wrong calendar
Commodities.summary: The Crude Oil market has spent the week busily unwinding a war that has not actually been settled.
Commodities.reason: Commentary that the market is unwinding a war-driven premium implies weaker oil prices as perceived risk falls; balanced but clearly bearish for crude in the near term.

Commodities.title: Mines, Logistics and Deep Uncertainty Threaten a Middle East Oil Rebound
Commodities.reason: Article highlights operational and logistical risks that could constrain a Middle East production rebound — a supply-side constraint supportive for oil prices; relevant to the broader oil supply narrative.

Commodities.title: For India, the Return of Iranian Oil Cannot Come Soon Enough
Commodities.reason: Piece about Iranian oil returning to markets implies additional supply to oil-importing countries like India — a negative price impulse for crude if volumes materialize; moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Panama Says Audit Found Broad Compliance at Idled Copper Mine
Commodities.reason: Audit finding of compliance at an idled copper mine raises prospect of restart or lower regulatory risk — incremental negative for copper prices via potential supply improvement; lower relevance (single-asset/regional).

Crypto.title: Federal Reserve Board requests comment on proposal to require certain payment stablecoin issuers to maintain an effective customer identification program
Crypto.summary: Federal Reserve Board requests comment on proposal to require certain payment stablecoin issuers to maintain an effective customer identification program
Crypto.reason: Fed-led proposal to impose bank-like customer ID rules on payment stablecoins is a major regulatory step that increases institutional clarity and AML credibility for stablecoins — net positive for adoption despite added compliance costs.

Crypto.title: U.S. agencies seek stablecoin customer-ID rules akin to banks in new GENIUS Act pitch
Crypto.reason: Media coverage reinforcing the regulatory push for bank-like KYC on stablecoins; supportive for institutional adoption but a regulatory compliance headwind for issuers.

Crypto.title: Franklin Templeton proposes new ETFs that turn corporate dividends into bitcoin
Crypto.reason: Institutional product innovation linking corporate dividends to bitcoin signals growing institutionalization and new demand pathways into BTC — meaningful positive for crypto adoption narrative.

Crypto.title: Alchemy's AI-driven identity and payment service gains access to Visa network
Crypto.reason: Access to Visa network via AI-driven identity/payments increases crypto payment rail integration and fiat on/off usability — positive for mainstream adoption and rails.

Crypto.title: GoMining challenges Jack Dorsey's Square with payments system designed around bitcoin
Crypto.reason: New payments entrant focused on Bitcoin rails represents competition and diversification of payment options — positive for BTC payment adoption but more niche in near term.

Crypto.title: Microsoft found malware that hijacks crypto wallets and spreads through USB sticks
Crypto.reason: Widespread malware stealing wallets increases security risks for users and custodians — negative for confidence and on‑chain flows, particularly retail.

Crypto.title: Ethereum's biggest 'sandwich' bot drained of $7.5 million in ironic exploit
Crypto.reason: Large exploit draining a major MEV/sandwich bot underscores smart-contract risk and fragility in DeFi — negative for DeFi token sentiment and risk appetite.

Crypto.title: AI is making crypto security cheaper, faster and harder to ignore
Crypto.reason: AI-driven security improvements reduce operational risk and costs for crypto firms and projects — incremental positive for ecosystem resilience.

Crypto.title: Algorand unveils roadmap to achieve quantum resistance by 2028
Crypto.reason: Protocol-level roadmap to quantum resistance is a positive technical development but limited near-term market impact.

Crypto.title: Digital credit market hit by huge selloff as Strive CEO blames leverage liquidations
Crypto.reason: Record selloff and leverage liquidations in digital credit markets are a systemic negative for crypto risk-on dynamics and can propagate distress across lending/DeFi.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin traders load up on bearish bets all the way down to $52,000
Crypto.reason: Elevated positioning in bearish derivatives contracts signals trader conviction of a deeper BTC pullback — negative for short-term price outlook and sentiment.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin falls below $63,000 as risk assets sell off and the week's bounce fades
Crypto.reason: Price breakdown below key levels and correlation with broader risk-off moves is a direct negative for crypto market sentiment and flows.

Crypto.title: Smart-contract and DeFi coins lead losses as bitcoin wilts for 4th straight day
Crypto.reason: DeFi and smart-contract token weakness amplifies the broader risk-off move, reinforcing negative sentiment across altcoins.

Crypto.title: Ex-Celsius CEO Mashinsky gets U.S. CFTC ban in final resolution with regulator
Crypto.reason: Enforcement action and bans against former CeFi executives are reputational negatives that underscore regulatory scrutiny, though they add clarity by resolving legacy cases.
